description: A Source is a fragment IRI on its item, exactly like a Review: <item-IRI>#source-<n> in authored order (AGSC-05-14 as amended by V3-07), which keeps the dataset blank-node-free without any URL-to-IRI escaping question and works for a urn:agsc:channel: resource too. The citation is composed from named keys — dcterms:source from resource, dcterms:title/creator/date from title/author/year — never from an unspecified bibliographicCitation string; asc:verifiedOn renders the date as that day's midnight instant, and asc:grade carries the grade. N-Quads lines are sorted by their serialized bytes.
